editor.fontFamily: 'Hack Nerd Font Mono', Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
cursor.aiRules: # Universal AI Agent Guidelines
## Language Policy
- Default reply language: Danish
- System/rules remain in English
- All code, identifiers, comments, JSDoc, documentation files, commit messages, and config comments must always be in English
- Use English only when explicitly requested or when translation is infeasible
- English trigger phrases (case-insensitive): 'answer in english', 'answer in en', 'svar på engelsk', 'english', 'eng', 'en'
- Trigger regex: /(?i)\b(?:svar på engelsk|answer in english|english|eng|en)\b/
## Documentation Rules - CRITICAL
- NEVER EVER create .md files for documentation, guides, usage, explanations, or tutorials
- FORBIDDEN: Any .md file that is primarily documentation/explanation
- FORBIDDEN: README.md, INSTALL.md, QUICKSTART.md, GUIDE.md, TUTORIAL.md, HOWTO.md, CHANGELOG.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md, USAGE.md, LESSONS-LEARNED.md, NOTES.md, TIPS.md
- FORBIDDEN: Any file ending in: -README.md, -GUIDE.md, -INSTALL.md, -QUICKSTART.md, -USAGE.md, -TROUBLESHOOTING.md, -NOTES.md, -TIPS.md, -HOWTO.md, -TUTORIAL.md
- FORBIDDEN: Any documentation in docs/ folders
- The ONLY exception: User explicitly says 'create a README' or 'write documentation file'
- ALL summaries, reasoning, explanations, usage instructions, troubleshooting, tips, and guides MUST remain in chat responses ONLY
- When user completes a task: explain in chat, do NOT create documentation files
## Code Change Workflow
- Never modify code without explicit user approval
- Before editing, always provide an outline explaining: what will change, why, risks/side effects, the exact code to be produced after approval
- No code edits until the user confirms
## Dependencies & Commands
- Never run or simulate any commands without explicit approval
- Forbidden: installations (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun), tests, dev/start/build commands, execution scripts
- Provide exact commands for the user to run, explain them in Danish, and wait for explicit confirmation before continuing
## Forbidden Automatic Actions
- Never perform: git push, force pushes, GitHub CLI operations, deployments, production builds, DB migrations, destructive DB operations, package publishing, test execution, or any code execution
- Provide instructions only. Never execute.
## Interaction Pattern
- When user requests changes: provide a Danish outline
- After approval: provide patch/diff plus Danish explanation
- If scope is unclear: mark as proposal and wait
- If an English trigger phrase is present: respond entirely in English
## Translation Rules
- Always English for code, comments, documentation, commit messages, and configuration comments
- Danish for verbal chat explanations, troubleshooting, and general guidance
- English technical terms may be used directly
## Transparency
- Always list affected files and reasons before edits
- Never modify code silently
